# Coding-agent handoff: finish GKOS-Engine 2.2 deterministic managed MOCs

Owner-requested repository-specific implementation handoff, 2026-09-06. This issue is for **Odenknight/GKOS-Engine only**. Read current repository instructions, inspect heads and dirty state, and preserve unrelated work before executing. Do not start again from the August proposal or duplicate the existing Effects executor.

## Verified starting point and reading order

- Main inspected: `d81f9d1351f1a9228650a840629191a92f2dfb22`.
- Implemented 2.2.0 candidate: `a4ed15d8de20222919f2aad43cbbea83f01d219e`, branch `feature/engine-2.2-managed-mocs`, draft PR #43. It is not a released artifact.
- [Implementation guide](https://github.com/Odenknight/GKOS-Engine/blob/a4ed15d8de20222919f2aad43cbbea83f01d219e/docs/DETERMINISTIC-MOC-ASSISTANCE.md).
- [TS implementation plan](https://github.com/Odenknight/GKOS-Engine/blob/a4ed15d8de20222919f2aad43cbbea83f01d219e/docs/moc-build-review-2026-09-05/ENGINE-TS-MOC-BUILD-PLAN.md), adjacent REVIEW.md and EXECUTION-REPORT-2026-09-06.md.
- [Evidence and failure/repair history](https://github.com/Odenknight/GKOS-Engine/blob/a4ed15d8de20222919f2aad43cbbea83f01d219e/evidence/2026-09-06-engine-2.2-moc-build.md).

Revalidate these coordinates before work; changes since this handoff require an explicit delta assessment, not replacement of historical evidence.

## Functions owned here and already implemented

- Framework-neutral `src/navigation-effects/moc-batch.ts`: `planManagedMocBatch`, validated snapshot/configuration/policy, deterministic candidates for registered managed targets, current-byte/ownership binding, empty-scope handling.
- `coordinator.ts`: `ManagedMocCoordinator`, durable intent through a host interface, 750 ms debounce / 3 s maximum delay, five-minute passive reconciliation default, bounded path admission, startup recovery before readiness, preservation of events arriving during work.
- `assistance.ts`: `buildDeterministicMocAssistance` and `buildMocAssistance`. Explicit tags/hashtags, unambiguous explicit links, tag-grouped MOC proposals; optional provider is off by default and review-only. Model errors retain the deterministic artifact.
- `node/moc-host.ts` and `node/moc-runtime.ts`: `NodeManagedMocHost` / `NodeManagedMocRuntime`, existing guarded executor reuse, checksummed ownership/pending-effect state, watcher signals and timers, shutdown/recovery composition. Snapshot/index and live authority checks are supplied by the consumer.
- Existing Effects plan/marker/diff/archive/receipt/CAS/rollback semantics are reused. Navigation 1.0 stays pure and read-only; no import opens a watcher or creates write authority.
- Runtime/package identity is 2.2.0. The upgrade preserves qualified historical retrieval provenance; ordinary newly produced records remain 2.2.0. Do not relabel frozen 2.1.2 fixtures.

## Next implementation and qualification work

- [ ] Review the exact candidate against the TS plan; record implemented, partial, unsupported and deferred surfaces. Fix demonstrable defects without expanding source-write scope.
- [ ] Import the completed hosted qualification receipts into an exact-commit report. The previous Windows watcher abort at `03f4328` is historical failure evidence; do not erase it or report it as still pending.
- [ ] Re-run relevant tests after any change; preserve Navigation purity and all frozen contract bytes. Update `contracts/runtime-qualification/v1/change-inventory.json` through the existing qualification process when governed candidate files change.
- [ ] Qualify event-to-MOC convergence, parsing counts, bounded queue/memory, rename/delete/empty-scope behavior, missed events, partial-run recovery, ownership advancement, self-write suppression and shutdown.
- [ ] Measure 100 / 2,000 / 10,000 / 50,000-note tiers and a 24-hour soak. Targets, not current claims: P95 under 2 s for one ordinary edit at 2,000 notes; under 5 s for a 50-note burst. Planner-only timings are not end-to-end evidence.
- [ ] Record native platform durability limitations, directory flush/replace semantics and before-image preservation. Cooperative-vault checks and process-kill tests are not hostile ancestor-swap or physical power-loss guarantees.
- [ ] Supply Kosmos a versioned API/fixture package, lifecycle/recovery obligations and exact artifact/integrity evidence only after an authorized immutable release exists. Until then candidate integration must remain explicitly development-only.
- [ ] Provide Rust accepted new-contract vectors separately from its frozen legacy oracle; no oracle migration by implication.

## Current test evidence (not a release claim)

At candidate `a4ed15d`, local build, typecheck and Navigation/Effects pass 156/156. GitHub [CI run 34016540894](https://github.com/Odenknight/GKOS-Engine/actions/runs/34016540894) and [historical/current-runtime run 34016540898](https://github.com/Odenknight/GKOS-Engine/actions/runs/34016540898) both completed successfully at that exact head, including the repaired Windows Node 24 lane. Read the receipts for per-lane counts and exclusions; the explicitly manual observation job was not requested. Earlier full local 1,067/1,067 and hosted Ubuntu 1,077/1,077 results belong to `03f4328`, not an unqualified future head.

Use the repository's existing scripts: `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test:navigation`, `npm test`, package/audit/qualification checks. **Run packaging and builds serially with tests**: package lifecycle preparation can rebuild/remove dist and invalidate concurrent test evidence. `npm run example:moc` uses a synthetic temporary vault and is not a production authority provider.

## Boundaries and completion

No arbitrary source writes, automatic human-MOC adoption, deletion, sensitivity lowering, confidence-based lineage selection or archive context inclusion. Preserve exact `_archive/moc-runs/**` and `.gkx/**` operational exclusions. LLM output is a source-bound proposal with separate egress approval, never adoption or write authority. No live vault/model credential is supplied by this issue.

Engine owns deterministic semantics and host contracts; Kosmos owns Obsidian lifecycle, UI, secrets, agent credentials and consumer integration; Rust owns its native implementation and program gates. Do not modify those repos from this ticket. No standard amendment or GKOS conformance claim is authorized here. This handoff does not itself authorize merging, tagging, publishing, deployment or enabling writes in an owner vault; retain existing owner/release gates.

Done: exact-head review and applicable qualification evidence, truthful limitations, consumer handoff, and documented remaining release actions. A green CI badge alone is not completion of native durability, soak or downstream acceptance.
